We are pleased to announce a PhD position on the topic "DYSCUSSION (DYScours: Universal Synthetic Communication through Science, Innovation, and Digital Tools)" at the MIS laboratory of the University of Picardie Jules Verne (UPJV - Amiens, France).

The project focuses on the design of a controlled linguistic generation system based on pictogram sequences, intended for Augmentative and Alternative Communication (AAC) devices.

This project is a collaborative effort involving the MIS and CRP-CPO laboratories of the UPJV, in partnership with the company Dyscoveri.
